---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Fuel efficiency by engine size and vehicle class in the mpg dataset."

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8, color = "grey35") +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs. Engine Size",
    subtitle = "A look at how vehicle class shapes economy",
    x = "Engine displacement (L)",
    y = "Highway fuel economy (mpg)",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
